conventions.prayerFactor: fraction of damage that gets THROUGH the correct protection prayer (0 = fully blocked, 1 = prayer does nothing); null = wiki silent
conventions.minHit: only where the wiki states one; null otherwise (game default is 0)
conventions.share: only where the wiki states a rotation; null otherwise

attacks.name: 3-hit standard (hit 1)
attacks.note: Rolls vs SLASH defence (+100 att bonus, 258 Att). Chain: a miss on hit N makes all later hits miss. Prayer does nothing.

attacks.name: 3-hit standard (hit 2)
attacks.note: Only lands if hit 1 landed (conditional accuracy).

attacks.name: 3-hit standard (hit 3)
attacks.note: Only lands if hits 1 and 2 landed.

attacks.name: Off-glyph curse tick
attacks.note: 1/tick doubling to 16/tick when off the imbued sigil; competent play = 0.

attacks.name: Blood Rain pool
attacks.note: Heals boss 2x damage dealt.

attacks.name: Blood Jaguar summon
attacks.note: Boss deals up to 15 to create the jaguars; reads as unavoidable (once per jaguar special).

attacks.name: Blood jaguar cleave
attacks.note: 6 attacks per special; heals boss 3x.

notes: Every hit heals the boss (1x/2x/3x, 3rd hit heals 30-50 flat) - damage taken feeds kill time; defence matters twice.
Rotation: 6 standard attacks then a special (alternating Rain/Jaguar); 156-tick cycle.
Standard-attack share by attack count ~6/7, by time unknown.

attacks.name: Melee auto
attacks.note: Infobox: 31 (auto). Uses one style at a time; switches only after the fire-bomb attack.

attacks.name: Magic auto
attacks.note: After a melee cycle the next style (magic/ranged) must be guessed - one wrong-prayer hit per switch is plausible.

attacks.name: Fire bombs
attacks.note: Every ~60 ticks (~10 attacks); 2 ticks to step off; 'can be unavoidable' near walls without ctrl-run.

notes: Cycle = ~10 autos of ONE style then a bomb; each style's share depends on the cycle, so per-kill share is a mixture, not 1/3 each.
First attack does ~75% less if prayed and shield down (opening-hit special case).
Multi-demon fights change behaviour (one melee, one magic/ranged, third only bombs).
unknowns: unknown: style-selection probabilities (melee if reachable, else random magic/ranged)
unknown: chance of a wrong-prayer hit on style switch

attacks.name: Ranged volley
attacks.note: 3 projectiles per attack; pattern R-R-R -> M-M-R/R-R-M after specials -> M-R-M late, so in mixed volleys ONE prayer cannot block all 3 unless flicked per projectile.

attacks.name: Magic volley
attacks.note: Bucket max hit list says 40 ranged / 36 magic for post-quest.

attacks.name: Melee double hit
attacks.note: Only if adjacent; 2nd hit mirrors the 1st; 'only partially reduced by prayer'. Awakened: 50-72 -> 37-52 with prayer (~0.72).

attacks.name: Tentacles
attacks.note: After every regular attack; -20% sanity. Dodged by L-move.

attacks.name: Corrupted Seeds failure
attacks.note: Dark seed step: 15-25.

notes: Infobox attack speed 10 conflicts with volley cadence; enrage drops to 2 ticks per attack, alternating style every 2 attacks.
Shadow Realm costs 3 prayer points per tick-group (prayer drain is a defensive cost the model doesn't track).
Sanity is a second HP bar - tentacle/special hits also cost sanity.
unknowns: unknown: true auto speed outside enrage
unknown: shares - specials at 80/55/30% HP, not per-attack

attacks.name: Melee auto
attacks.note: Max 32 at full HP rising linearly to 43 at low HP (strength scales with missing HP). Protect from Melee -75% (8-10). Heals 50% of damage.
attacks.unknown: unknown: accuracy - 280 Att +190 bonus, 'very accurate regardless of armour'

attacks.name: Swinging Axes
attacks.note: 1-3 axes by HP; Protect from Melee ~halves. Bleed 15+ over 14 ticks.

attacks.name: Darting Spikes
attacks.note: Heals boss 50%.

attacks.name: Strangle
attacks.unknown: unknown: 'high damage' (awakened text implies ~25 normal, ~40 awakened)

attacks.name: Head gaze
attacks.note: No damage; failing drains 10 prayer and disables overheads for 3 ticks (lets the body hit unprayed).

notes: Special attacks are RANDOM, not a rotation - shares are unknowable from the wiki.
Enrage at 33% HP: more axes/heads.

attacks.name: Icicles (melee range)
attacks.note: 11 unprayed, 5 with Protect from Melee (stated as max values; ratio 0.45). Ward of Arceuus capped.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.note: 42 through prayer; always hits; dodged by stepping off (standard play: attack 2 of 3 cycles).

attacks.name: Magic spit (out of melee)
attacks.note: 'Slightly less' with Protect from Magic; awakened 71 -> 36 through prayer (~0.5). Avoided by staying in melee.

attacks.name: Freezing Gaze
attacks.note: Every 5th standard attack; hide behind a pillar.

attacks.name: Gas Flare
attacks.note: Reduced by slayer helmet / gas mask (gear-dependent damage reduction).

notes: Gaze share = 1 in 5 attack slots (stated). Enrage <25%: speed 4.

unknowns: unknown: whether competent players take icicles every cycle or avoid them

attacks.name: Melee orb

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.note: Only if adjacent to the pool; no warning.

attacks.name: Roar chip
attacks.note: End of every volley - unavoidable chip (per volley, not per second).

attacks.name: Smoke Blast
attacks.note: Infobox says 60.

notes: Volley sequence (stated): 3t mag/rng, 2t mag/rng, 2t all three, 1t mag/rng, 1t all three, faster projectiles x2; stuns reset progress.

attacks.name: Melee (3-hit chain)

attacks.name: Magic (Ancients, AoE)

attacks.name: Shadow shots (shadow phase)
attacks.note: Damage scales with proximity; 30 max through prayer up close.

attacks.name: Blood Sacrifice
attacks.note: 'through Protect from Magic'; bystanders take up to 12.

attacks.name: Containment

attacks.name: Smoke Rush poison
attacks.note: Bucket: poisonous Yes (8).

notes: Team boss: incoming damage depends on targeting (nearest player, lowest defence roll) and team size - per-player share is not a property of the boss.
